routing.task_class: Explicitly selected Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) coordination with official GUI Codex subagents and deterministic .CAO workflow-state control
natural_language_triggers: select the bundled Coding Agent Orchestrator skill
Use Coding Agent Orchestrator for this coding objective
continue this already active Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow
routing.primary_route: Activate only for an explicitly selected coding objective. Before production or delegation, resolve or initialize the target repository's .CAO state and preserve related task identity, scope, decisions, TODO progress, dynamic-role assignments, collections, audit evidence, finalization, and handoff. Record worker contracts through the state CLI, execute workers only through official Codex collaboration tools, and record terminal results before integration and finalization.
fallback_conditions: When official collaboration tools are unavailable, stop CAO execution, preserve exact .CAO state, and report the safe resume boundary without emulating delegation.
non_use_conditions: Do not activate from a bare plugin attachment, plugin inspection, discovery question, troubleshooting request, generic coding request, or generic subagent request.
Do not activate from an incidental CAO mention, non-leading CAO occurrence, or lowercase cao.
Do not activate from .CAO directory presence or prior state alone.
Do not treat continuation outside an already active explicitly selected workflow as activation.

trigger_phrases: Select the bundled Coding Agent Orchestrator skill
aliases: コーディング・エージェント・オーケストレーター

interface.default_prompt: Use $coding-agent-orchestrator for this coding objective: inspect or initialize .CAO state, record dynamic-role assignments and results, and run workers only through official Codex subagents.

inputs.name: Coding outcome and repository
inputs.description: The requested result, jobsite, applicable instructions, authority boundary, and source state.

inputs.name: Workflow state
inputs.description: The current .CAO task identity, epoch, scope, decisions, TODO progress, assignments, collections, lifecycle state, evidence, and handoff.

inputs.name: Dynamic worker contracts
inputs.description: Objective-derived responsibility names with exclusive scope, authoritative inputs, complete output, permissions, stop conditions, acceptance evidence, and finite descendant permission.

outputs.name: Official-subagent execution
outputs.description: Bounded dynamically named responsibilities executed only through the official Codex collaboration surface.

outputs.name: Integrated coding result
outputs.description: Parent-integrated source or artifacts with one task-sized acceptance decision.

outputs.name: Finalized workflow state
outputs.description: Validated .CAO records for task, decisions, assignments, collections, audit evidence, completion, and handoff.

workflow_contract.execution_rule: The state CLI records and validates workflow state but never launches workers. Official Codex collaboration tools are the sole worker-execution route.
workflow_contract.role_rule: Use unrestricted dynamic responsibility names derived from the actual objective. Never preallocate a fixed roster or enforce a role-name allowlist.
workflow_contract.state_rule: .CAO is required workflow state for every activated objective and preserves related continuation exactly.
workflow_contract.acceptance_rule: Use one task-sized semantic acceptance bundle, then finalize and validate the matching workflow state. Success ends verification.
